full_name: Nancy J. Chodorow | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Professor of sociology and clinical professor of psychology at the University of California at Berkeley, Nancy J. Chodorow is also a faculty member of the San Francisco Psychoanalytic Institute and a psychoanalyst in private practice.
